decisions.semantics: Full count, ordered IDs including duplicates, optional prefix/count-only. Shared bounded 128-record reads with FindRow; caller rejects partial output on failure.

decisions.decision: Only new commit selects the app probe for --print-scaled in the upstream launcher. Native Cachyborne launcher resolves profile.probe directly; no corresponding BB_PREBUILT fallback exists.

decisions: Stored specialization Info rebases to its resident Program in both insertion paths. Standalone ASan/UBSan regression reproduces heap-use-after-free with the previous header and passes after correction. Full suite, 110 retail CTest cases without skips and physical 120-second native capture pass.
Version constants already shared by runtime/rebuild/import. Do not accept foreign version-24 caches: native shader-build identity and key version 8 differ.
Native metadata actually stores two object-motion addresses. Removing them as in the foreign fork would corrupt the local layout.
Native BlobStore writer already drains queued writes on Close. Profile-before-import synchronization still requires comparison.

Native BlobStore already drained writes on Close. Added a sequence-based Flush visibility barrier before a recipe import child is spawned, including active writes and explicit I/O failure propagation. FIFO-blocked worker/two waiter tests, previous-file preservation, reopen failure reset, close drain and separate-process profile reads pass. This is not fsync durability or a measured FPS gain. The final store destructor also wakes, drains and joins the writer if explicit Close was omitted; worker state outlives the jthread. Final retail, sanitizer and physical default-path qualification pass.
Equivalent-specialization preload reuse, stale-meta retirement, impossible-recipe memoization and save-manager comparison remain pending.

Reviewed runtime save safepoint: file copying is inside _WIN32 only, while Linux still writes success metadata/logs. It overwrites one fixed backup and performs synchronous I/O under the save mount lock. Do not port as a verified Linux backup; backup/restore utility requires a separate atomic, tested implementation.

physical_verification.scope: One 120-second physical DP-2 Mensis lamp camera sweep with the normal published profile and no test preload, PipeWire USB sink, copied saves.

cache_import_flush.sanitizers: Final instrumented store and test pass ASan/UBSan, including separate-process profile read, two simultaneous waiters, active-write barrier, error preservation, reopen reset and scope destructor drain.
limits: The published default has no recipe pack configured, so its physical capture verifies default-path stability, not a complete translation/import of a populated recipe pack.
Flush waits for queued file publication, not durable fsync; I/O failures remain failures.

movement_verification.scope: Copied-save bounded walk/backstep pulses at the Hunter Dream entry lamp. Headless with dummy audio, 1 Hz host resource diagnostics. No full-area, combat, physical gamepad or energy-minimum claim.
limits: Process RSS excludes other host/driver/direct-memory allocations.
Whole-board power includes other desktop clients; no global resource-minimum or causal energy-saving claim.

cache_identity_followup.finding: The shader fingerprint source set includes the complete gpu/CMakeLists.txt. Adding test-only targets changes the production shader-build identity and rebuilds caches, although those additions do not alter shader translation.
